description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceTrackerLogDao within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It tests methods for retrieving performance tracker logs by ID, tracker ID, and log rate counts.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing PerformanceTrackerLogDao methods related to performance tracker logs in the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PerformanceTrackerLogDao instance and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a PerformanceTrackerLog by its ID, verifying related entities.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Tests fetching logs by tracker ID with different scenarios (with logs, without logs, non-existent).

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Tests counting logs with positive and negative achievement rates.
